图像到视频工作流程，可轻松设置多个自定义 LoRa

- 说明 -

此工作流程主要适合那些只想轻松设置和使用的初学者，我发现大多数自定义工作流程对于新手（包括我自己）来说非常难以理解。

我已经编写了您设置和开始生成作品所需的所有说明。

步骤一：

从此处下载压缩的 .json 文件，一旦获得它，您将解压缩并提取它

您需要在计算机上找到 Comfy UI 会话文件夹并将 json 文件直接放入工作流程文件夹中，现在最初发现这一点可能很棘手，因此这是您想要使用的路径：

本电脑/本地磁盘(C:)/用户/[你的用户名]/AppData/本地/舒适桌面

安装 Comfy 时，您可以选择执行基于云的会话或创建您命名的本地会话，因此，如果您还没有这样做，只需创建一个新会话，然后当您转到上面的此路径时，只需单击具有会话名称的会话，暂时忽略其他会话

步骤 2：使用下面的路径将工作流程拖放到您的工作流程文件夹中

C：\用户\您的用户在这里\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\此处为您的会话名称\ComfyUI\用户\默认\工作流程

一旦你把它放进去，它应该看起来像上面的图片

步骤3：

启动 Comfy UI 并登录到本地会话

转到工作流程选项卡，它应该位于模型下

  • 然后单击并加载工作流程，一旦完成，您将看到以下内容：

如果 Comfy UI 给你错误并显示“缺少模型/节点等” 不要惊慌，因为这是预料之中的事情

第4步：

  • 您将转到错误选项卡，查找显示“全部下载”的选项，然后单击它

  • 将会发生的情况是，舒适的 UI 将下载与工作流程相关的所有资源，例如：模型、检查点、自定义节点以及它拾取的其他任何内容，一旦下载完成，您应该会看到右上角的下载通知将变为绿色，这意味着它已完成，您需要重新启动 Comfy UI，

  • 在舒适的 UI 中安装任何新内容时始终重新启动

重新启动程序后，它现在应该可以工作了

以下是有关工作流程步骤如何运作的简单视觉指南：

一切都已接线并准备就绪，您所要做的就是插入以下内容；

  • 输入图像

  • 无论你想尝试什么劳拉

  • 积极提示

一些可能有帮助的初学者技巧；

  • 永远使用最多的高品质可以的图像，必要时升级

  • 对于这个工作流程，我不会弄乱 Ksampler 节点，除非你知道自己在做什么，否则你可能会得到各种丑陋的输出

  • 如果你得到视频模糊并且您没有弄乱 Ksamplers，这很可能是因为您使用的图像质量低/差，或者您添加的洛拉之一引起了冲突（在这种情况下，只需降低或提高自定义洛拉强度，直到它变得平滑，不要调整闪电洛拉强度），我最近重新安装了所有内容，并且通过使用高质量图像作为我的输入，我能够在同一天启动此工作流程并与可靠的生成器一起运行

  • 万2.2基础模型仅限6次创作，这意味着，如果您尝试延长持续时间超过 6 秒，它要么会重置图像的起始位置，要么会减慢视频的速度，如果您希望延长持续时间，您需要找到一个以此为基础构建的自定义工作流程。

  • 较高的宽度/高度尺寸受限于您的电脑的功能和工作流程，我目前在 5060 16GB 上运行它，它可以以良好的质量完成大多数操作，但在某一点之后，如果没有足够的内存，舒适的 UI 将崩溃，这部分与此工作流程设置为仅使用 4 个步骤并最大化速度有关，如果您想要更高的视觉保真度，我建议尝试具有更高步骤的不同工作流程

  • 找不到您的输入或输出？搜索此文件夹“ComfyUI-shared”，他们最近将它们全部移至此处，因此如果您想查找您的创作，请打开它，它将包含您的“输入”和“输出”文件的文件夹

  • 下载的 Lora's 放在哪里这是常识，但是当您下载 loras 时，您需要将它们专门放置在下面的文件夹路径中：

C：\用户\你的用户名\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\你的会话名称\ComfyUI\models\loras

就是这样，如果您有任何一般性问题，请随时在评论中提出，我无论如何都不是专家，但我会尽我所能，祝您好运并享受！

Image to Video Workflow for easy setup with multiple custom loras

- INSTRUCTIONS -

This workflow is mainly for beginners who just want something easy to setup and go, I've found that most custom workflows are incredibly hard for new people to understand (myself included).

I've written all the instructions you'll need to setup and start generating your creations.

Step 1:

Download the zipped .json file from here then once you got it you'll unzip and extract it

You're going to want to locate your Comfy UI session folder on your computer and place the json file directly within the workflows folder, now finding this initially can be tricky so here's the path you wanna use:

This PC/Local Disk (C:)/Users/ [your user name]/AppData/Local/Comfy-Desktop

When you install Comfy, you have the option to do a cloud based session or create your local session that you name, so if you haven't done that, just create a new session and then when you go to this path above, you just click on the one that has the session name, ignore the others for now

Step 2: Drop the workflow in your workflows folder using this path below

C:\Users\your user here\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\your session name here\ComfyUI\user\default\workflows

Once you drop it in, it should look like the image above

Step 3:

Launch Comfy UI and sign into your local session

Go to the workflows tab, it should be under models

  • Then Click and load the workflow, once you do you'll see this:

If Comfy UI gives you errors and says "missing models/nodes etc." Don't panic because that's expected to happen

Step 4:

  • You'll go to the error tab, look for an option that says "download all" and click on it

  • What will happen is that comfy UI will then download any and all the resources that are relevant to the workflow such as; models, checkpoints, custom nodes and anything else it picks up, once it's done downloading you should see the top right download notification will be green, that means that it's completed and you'll need to restart Comfy UI,

  • ALWAYS RESTART WHEN INSTALLING ANYTHING NEW IN COMFY UI

Once you've restarted the program, it should now work

Below is a simple visual guide on how the workflow steps function:

Everything is already wired and ready to go, all you have to do is just plug in the following;

  • The input image

  • Whatever loras you want to try

  • Positive prompt

Some beginner tips that may help;

  • ALWAYSuse the mosthigh qualityimages you can, upscale if necessary

  • For this workflow I would not mess with the Ksampler nodes unless you know what you're doing otherwise you may get all kinds of ugly outputs

  • If you getblurry videosand you haven't messed with the Ksamplers it's most likely because the image you used is low/poor quality or one of the loras you added is causing conflict (in which case just lower or higher the custom lora strengths until it comes out smooth, do NOT adjust the lightning loras strengths), I recently reinstalled everything and I was able to get this workflow up and running with solid gens the same day by using high quality images for my inputs

  • Wan 2.2 base model is limited to 6 second creations, this means that if you try to extend the duration passed 6 seconds it will either reset the starting position of the image or it will slow down the pace of the video, if you're looking to extend the duration you'll need to find a custom workflow that was built with that in mind.

  • Higher width/height dimensions are limited to your PC's capabilities and the workflow,I'm currently running this on an 5060 16GB which can do most things in good quality but after a certain point comfy UI will crash if there's not enough memory, this is partly to do with the fact that this workflow is setup to only use 4 steps and maximize speed, if you want higher visual fidelity I would suggest trying a different workflow with higher steps

  • Can't find your inputs or outputs? Search for this folder "ComfyUI-shared", they recently moved them all here so if you're trying to find your creations open it and it'll contain the folders for your "input" and "output" files

  • Where to put downloaded Lora'sThis is more so general knowledge but when you download loras, you want to specifically place them in this folder path below:

C:\Users\your username\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\yoursession name\ComfyUI\models\loras

That's really it, if you have any general questions feel free to ask away in the comments, I'm not an expert by any means but I'll do what I can, best of luck and enjoy!
